media.title: Henry Koster — Universal-International press photograph, 1961
media.altText: Black-and-white press photograph of the film director Henry Koster.
media.publicCaption: Henry Koster, who directed Three Smart Girls in 1936, the Deanna Durbin debut that carried two songs by Kaper and Jurmann. The photograph is a later studio still, made for Flower Drum Song in 1961.
media.publicCreditLine: Universal-International, press photograph for Flower Drum Song, 1961; Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States. The Wikimedia Commons file carries the PD-US-not-renewed tag: the photograph was published in the United States in 1961, within the 1931–1963 window in which copyright had to be renewed, and no renewal is recorded. The Commons file page notes that the image may remain protected in jurisdictions that do not apply the rule of the shorter term to United States works.
